name: aci-bench-medarc-eval
description: aci-bench-medarc-eval is a medical-domain evaluation benchmark designed to assess model performance on clinical/medical question answering, evidence-based response generation, and safe information retrieval. It focuses on correctness of medical answers, alignment with supporting references, and identification of harmful or hallucinated content. The benchmark is intended for evaluating clinical LLMs and systems used in medical information tasks.
reputation: A niche medical evaluation set used in clinical NLP research and model safety assessments, with limited but focused community use.
